data.name: Orc_Wizard_Example_MainView_Description
data.value:
This example will show you how to use the wizard elements in Orc.Wizard. The code is fairly easy to understand. Even though this demo isn't very meaningful it illustrates the real power of the wizard in combination with Catel:
- State management (remember values when navigating between views) - Views can be used inside and outside of the wizard - Validation per view model or model - Easy to code, seriously, check it out for yourself!

data.name: Orc_Wizard_Example_PersonWizardPageView_Description
data.value:
This wizard page shows you how to map textbox elements to a model and validate them. Notice that you cannot move to the next page while the fields are not yet valid. When navigating forward and back, you will see the values are automatically restored.
The cool thing is that the view model for this page only has 28 (!) lines of code. This means your pages stay small and are easily maintainable.
